definitions.explanation: The arrangement and organization of parts in a system.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{構造|こうぞう}
{複雑|ふくざつ}な{構造|こうぞう}
{社会|しゃかい}の{構造|こうぞう}は{時代|じだい}とともに{大|おお}きく{変化|へんか}してきた。
examples.english: The structure of society has changed greatly over time.

notes:
{構造|こうぞう} refers to the internal arrangement of parts that make up a whole — how something is built or organized. It applies to physical objects, systems, and abstract concepts alike.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {構造|こうぞう}{的|てき}: structural (as a na-adjective)
- {構造|こうぞう}{改革|かいかく}: structural reform
- {構造|こうぞう}{上|じょう}の{問題|もんだい}: structural problem
- {構造|こうぞう}{物|ぶつ}: a structure (physical)

TYPICAL DOMAINS:
- {社会|しゃかい}{構造|こうぞう}: social structure
- {経済|けいざい}{構造|こうぞう}: economic structure
- {文|ぶん}の{構造|こうぞう}: sentence structure
- {建物|たてもの}の{構造|こうぞう}: building structure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {仕組|しく}み: mechanism, how something works (more everyday)
- {組|く}み{立|た}て: assembly, construction (emphasizes the process)
